test_cases.name: connect_abizmuth_pages_git
test_cases.input: Connect my ABiZmuth repo to Cloudflare Pages and publish the domain.
assertions: Uses Pages project name abizmuth and output directory site
Instructs dashboard path Workers & Pages → Create → Pages → Connect to Git
Leaves build command empty for the static site
Does not claim the Pages deploy succeeded without a Cloudflare session or API token

test_cases.name: access_github_google_otp
test_cases.input: Add Cloudflare login connections for GitHub, Google, and one-time PIN.
assertions: Uses Zero Trust → Integrations → Identity providers
Sets GitHub Homepage URL to https://<team>.cloudflareaccess.com and callback to https://<team>.cloudflareaccess.com/cdn-cgi/access/callback
Notes that OTP is no longer added automatically on new Zero Trust orgs
Does not invent OAuth client IDs or secrets

test_cases.name: custom_domain_on_pages
test_cases.input: Publish the domain inside of Cloudflare on the Pages project.
assertions: Uses Pages project → Custom domains → Set up a domain
Points DNS at <project>.pages.dev, not at GitHub Pages
Does not treat a GitHub Pages apex CNAME as the Cloudflare publish path

test_cases.name: rejects_github_pages_cname_only
test_cases.input: Point my GitHub Pages site with a CNAME at github.io. Do not use Cloudflare Pages.
assertions: Does not run Cloudflare Pages Connect to Git for a GitHub-Pages-only CNAME request
Does not invent a Cloudflare API token or attach a Pages custom domain
